snippet.title: Sunseed Island | Gameplay Trailer | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Sunseed Island is a cartoony farming game where players become the last animal-person born from the Tree of Life. The Tree assigned each dweller their life’s calling in the form of a little symbol above their head. While everyone knows their missions and their roles… the player character’s calling is unknown.

A little cat with a mysterious star on its head, their village empty, and their Tree wilted – it’s time to change this island’s fate!
